'''Dya-Tamm''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] who lived during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. During the war she lived on the capital [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of the Republic, [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] where she worked in the Equipment Requisitions area of the [[Senate Commercial District]] as a vendor of various goods.<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Badna first appeared in the MMORPG ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', released by [[BioWare]] in [[2011]], as a security key vendor, accessible only to players who purchased security keys for the game. She is only accessible to Republic players in the game as she is found on Coruscant which is a Republic only planet.
